# 90-Minute Cross-Functional Meeting Plan

## Meeting Structure for June 14, 2025 at 2:00 PM ET
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/calendar.svg

This agenda is optimized for **8 participants** across product, engineering, and design, with time reserved for decisions, ownership, and wrap-up. The flow moves from blockers to launch-date decision, then ends with clear action assignment.

## Minute-by-Minute Agenda
| Time | Segment | Purpose | Output |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0:00–0:05 | Opening and goals | Align on meeting objective, decision needed, and timebox | Shared expectations |
| 0:05–0:15 | Sprint blocker review | Surface the highest-impact blockers from each function | Blocker list with priority |
| 0:15–0:25 | Blocker triage | Confirm which blockers need discussion vs. offline follow-up | Sorted blockers and next steps |
| 0:25–0:35 | Launch readiness snapshot | Review key dependencies, risks, and readiness gaps | Readiness status by area |
| 0:35–0:50 | Launch date decision | Compare 1–2 feasible dates and decide on one | Final launch date |
| 0:50–1:05 | Owner assignment | Assign owners for blockers, launch tasks, and follow-ups | Action-item ownership list |
| 1:05–1:15 | Risk check and mitigation | Validate remaining risks and backup plans | Mitigation actions |
| 1:15–1:25 | Recap and confirmation | Read back decisions, owners, and deadlines | Confirmed action log |
| 1:25–1:30 | Close | Confirm follow-up communication and next checkpoint | Meeting closure |

## Recommended Agenda Design
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/clock.svg

- Keep the first 25 minutes tightly focused on blockers so the group does not spend the whole meeting in status updates.
- Make the launch-date decision a hard midpoint decision, not an end-of-meeting item.
- Use a visible decision rule: if a blocker is unresolved by 10 minutes, assign an owner and due date rather than extending discussion.
- Capture decisions in real time so the final 15 minutes are only for confirmation and cleanup.

## Concise Follow-Up Summary Template
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/chat-square-text.svg

**Subject:** Meeting recap — blockers, launch date, and owners

**Summary**
- Date/time: June 14, 2025, 2:00–3:30 PM ET
- Attendees: 8 participants from product, engineering, and design
- Decisions made: [launch date], [key blocker decisions]

**Key Decisions**
- Launch date: [final date]
- Scope changes: [brief note]
- Risks accepted: [brief note]

**Action Items**
- [Owner] — [task] — [due date]
- [Owner] — [task] — [due date]
- [Owner] — [task] — [due date]

**Open Risks**
- [risk] — owner: [name] — status: [mitigation or next step]

**Next Checkpoint**
- [date/time] — [purpose]

## Quick Actions
Action: [Button: Add to calendar] https://calendar.google.com/
Action: [Button: Share recap] https://docs.google.com/
